dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; uniform high-intensity pixel distribution across the majority of the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, faint bluish-grey clusters distributed primarily along the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary mature white baseline and the localized posterior pigmentation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small cluster of low-contrast circular white marks on the lower-left quadrant of the dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear dorsal ridge along the posterior central axis creating a distinct shadow-casting topological disruption.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized circular depigmented lesions on the mid-to-lower left dorsal area.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark circular aperture corresponding to the blowhole at the anterior apex.
